title: pseudocystopteris atkinsonii
intro: Pseudocystopteris atkinsonii, commonly known as Atkinson's fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Pseudocystopteris atkinsonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
